text:
mira: :rotating_light: Observing a sustained spike in 5xx from eu-west inference cluster over the last 6m. GPU pool shows NIC errors on several nodes, packet drops + retransmits. Can we partially divert traffic?
infra-bot: ALERT: eu-west/gpu-pool-3 kernel: mlx5_core error: EQ overflow -> port flaps detected (logs: /var/log/cluster/eu-west/if-errors.log)
jon: On it. Pulling pool health now. If NICs are flapping we should reduce gslb weight instead of full failover to avoid overload elsewhere.
sam: Agree. Suggest a gradual partial divert: move 50% of user traffic off eu-west to eu-central, 20% to na-west as spill. Keep ~30% to eu-west for canary and debug.
lina: We have ~25% spare headroom in eu-central; na-west has capacity but higher cost. If we push more to na-west cost may jump ~10-15%.
mira: @jon plan: apply a staged weight change over 3m. Start with eu-west -> 30, eu-central -> 50, na-west -> 20. Monitor 5xx and p95. Rollback if 5xx doesn't drop in 2m.
jon: Running gslb update now. Command I'm using:
```
# staged update, 180s rollout
gslbctl update-weights \
  --region eu-west=30 \
  --region eu-central=50 \
  --region na-west=20 \
  --rollout 180s
```
infra-bot: gslbctl: request accepted, rollout started at 2024-06-11T12:14:16Z. New weights in propagation.
ops-runbook: Reminder: set client-cache TTL to 30s during the rollout (runbook step 3) to avoid stale routing. Also update the incident channel and link to the infra pager.
sam: Done TTL -> 30s. Watching metrics: within 60s p95 latency down ~18%, 5xx rate from 3.4% -> 1.1%.
lina: Cost heads-up: if we sustain na-west at 20% for 24h estimate +12% infra cost. We can re-optimize after nodes are patched.
jon: Good progress. I'll keep a small pool in eu-west (30%) so we can capture NIC level logs and avoid cold-starts elsewhere. If remaining errors persist or eu-west pool degrades further, we'll evacuate completely and run emergency scaled quantized replicas in eu-central.
mira: Please open a follow-up ticket for NIC firmware upgrade + drain plan for affected hosts. Also add a note to the region runbook about preferring eu-central for spillovers.
infra-bot: gslbctl: rollout complete. Reachability healthchecks OK for eu-central/na-west. eu-west health still reporting intermittent link errors.
sam: Monitoring shows 5xx at 0.8% and tail latency improving. Will keep an eye for next 30m and then start triage.
mira: Thanks everyone. I'll start the incident postmortem and coordinate with hw team for firmware rollout. If anything spikes tag @oncall.
ops-runbook: Logged incident -> INC-2024-0643, assigned to mira. Next step: schedule firmware window and list impacted hosts.
infra-bot: ALERT CLEARED: major 5xx spike mitigated by traffic redistribution. Keep monitoring for regressions. :white_check_mark:
